method: Exactly two ordinary terminal attempts through visible driver TTY JSON input; screenshots inspected. No source, tests, builds, hidden state, other reports, or other logs read.

observations: Killed induction warden after moving close and aiming upward.
West and east recovery worked on first hold; supplies visibly restored.
Heart first moving burst missed, stationary correction killed warden.
Return ran into central solid cover; strafing cleared it.
Held extraction near edge; incoming fire reduced shield but mission completed.
Initial forward Shift yielded PHASE EVADE; induction warden survived and appeared again at extraction.
Multiple aiming bursts at east sentinel missed before successful correction.
First east recovery hold was too far: MOVE CLOSER / STEP INSIDE FLOOR RING appeared; a short advance solved it.
Shot toward a capacitor then dashed sideways; no discharge confirmation, so successful trigger not claimed.
North/west service detour hit walls repeatedly; health fell to 65 before west recovery restored it to 85.
Phase break canceled a sentinel shot and changed its face to white; follow-up shots missed.
Extraction baffles provided useful visual cover, though flanks continued to damage shield.

assessment.gameplay: A complete short recover-and-return loop with useful optic precision, shield recovery, phase timing and cover. Two wins despite low accuracy and very few eliminations suggest traversal/objective rushing is forgiving; longer western detour produced meaningful pressure. Combat choices exist but the tiny sample and short mission limit depth claims.
assessment.presentation: Strong coherent teal/amber storm atmosphere, wet floor lighting, relay landmark, title layout and clean end screen. Close views reveal simple block geometry, sparse props, repeated robot forms and flat walls; visually polished prototype rather than AAA finish.
assessment.usability: Menu, brief, map, objective beacons and recovery feedback supported completion. Paused map was understandable. West service labels did not prevent repeated wall detours; map could have helped more if reopened. CTRL sprint/Shift phase require attention but are documented.
assessment.readability: Health/ammo/objective and core confirmation clear. Amber robot optics contrast well. Distant targets are small; muted chevrons and numeric direction cues were hard to act on among cover and announcements. Some beacon labels and nearest-distance text overlapped scene signs. Extraction near-edge and move-within-deck messages allowed successful adjustment.
assessment.aaaReadiness: Functionally complete slice in this sample, with stable menu-to-win flow and no observed page errors. Geometry, animation/variety, scope and combat depth do not yet support an AAA readiness claim.
